notes.notes:
We are excited to announce Rytmik Studio. New version of Rytmik. We’ve been working on Rytmik Studio for a long time now. Rytmik Studio will come with a fairly large number of samples, but will also allow you to import new ones freely. Your voice or a recording of your guitar can become the basis of the instrument. More than 7,000 songs have already been shared on Rytmik Cloud, and the new version of Rytmik will be backward compatible. We would like to complete new Rytmik sooner. notes.title: Rytmik Cloud Expansion
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10945792/9c289840826d29fc5dbcc4785c16f66425524ea5.png[/img]

Rytmik Ultimate allows you to share songs with other users using the Rytmik Cloud and to play songs stored in Rytmik Cloud. Users can also exchange their compositions and cooperate on them.

[h1]Slots[/h1]
Each user has a limited number of slots on Rytmik Cloud. Purchasing the basic version of Rytmik Ultimate gives you 40 slots. You can get more slots in several ways.

[list]
[*] Getting [i]The Musician (Silver Disc)[/i] achievement adds you another 5 slots. 
[*] Getting [i]The Music Star (Gold Disc)[/i] achievement adds you another 5 slots.
[*] Getting [i]The Hitmaker (Platinum Disc)[/i] achievement adds you another 5 slots.
[*] DLC [i]Rytmik Cloud Expansion[/i] adds you another 42 slots.
[*] DLC [i]Rytmik Cloud Expansion 2[/i] adds you another 210 slots.
[/list]

[h1]How RYTMIK CLOUD works[/h1]
When you select the PUBLIC CLOUD or USER CLOUD category, Rytmik Ultimate connects to the shared storage called Rytmik Cloud. To use this feature, you need a functional network connection. When storing a song, you can specify its access privileges (UNLOCKED, LOCKED, SEMI-LOCKED or PRIVATE). UNLOCKED means the song will be visible for all and everyone can load and edit it. LOCKED means that the song will be visible for all, but other users can only play it using PREVIEW function and won’t be able to edit it. SEMI-LOCKED means that the song will be visible for all, other users can only play it using PREVIEW function, but clips can be used, modified and redistributed. PRIVATE means that other users can’t see the song.


http://store.steampowered.com/app/697380/Rytmik_Cloud_Expansion/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/697410/Rytmik_Cloud_Expansion_2/

notes.title: New Tutorial - Chords
notes.notes:
We added Instrument Chord mode in Update 1.7. 

Short video tutorial here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ya8BRby7guU

[h1]Instrument Chord mode[/h1]
[list]
[*]Allows multiple notes to be played at once from one instrument
[*]Pressing PC/Mac Keyboard rewrites selected note(s)
[*]CTRL+ PC/Mac Keyboard adds note(s) to selected position
[*]LMB at pitch note area transposes selected chord
[*]CTRL+LMB – adds note to the chord or adjusts selected note pitch
[*]CTRL+RMB – removes last note from the chord
[*]Adjust note VOLUME or parameters B,C,D by LMB - set all chord notes together. Or LMB + CTRL - set only selected note.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11607168/389b00946627a09c0535d8ff10e66101773821a6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New DLC Work in Progress - Rytmik Ultimate - Voice & Acoustic Expansion
notes.notes:
The upcoming [i]Voice & Acoustic Expansion DLC for Rytmik Ultimate[/i] is focusing on recorded sounds such as acoustic instruments and voices. Do you want to participate and hear your samples in [i]Rytmik Ultimate[/i]? We offer you a unique opportunity to add your sample(s) to this upcoming DLC.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10945792/7480c86050cdf65a2a30aab4c25c0a1fa876eb61.jpg[/img]

[b]How to do it?[/b]

Record an acoustic instrument or a voice or any other interesting/unique sound. It must be recorded by yourself (sounds from any other sample banks are not allowed). Then send it to samples@rytmikultimate.com. You can send up to 1 MB, for bigger files please send us a download link. If we find your recording interesting and useful, we will add it to the library. You will get the [i]Voice & Acoustic Expansion DLC[/i] for free as a reward.

https://youtu.be/LhekHp8pmw0
